title: Cleaning-company workers’ wage strike at Ministry of Education schools
location: Schools served by Ministry of Education cleaning contractors; specific sites and gathering place unknown
scope: Collective work stoppage/strike; extent and sites unknown
threshold_50_evidence: No count or clear qualitative estimate of simultaneous participants appears in available evidence. A strike is reported, but this does not alone prove a public gathering of 50 or more.

occurrence.summary: Gulf News and the Ministry of Education report a strike by cleaning-company workers contracted to Ministry schools; the Ministry said the crisis had ended by its 5 December statement.

start_date.summary: Exact start date and onset month are unknown. The Ministry release dated 5 December 2024 says the crisis over the strike had ended; Gulf News says the strike had been defused by 6 December. These resolution reports do not establish the first strike/gathering date or month.

end_date.summary: Ministry release dated 5 December 2024 says the strike crisis had ended; this is evidence the crisis was reported resolved by that date, not a separate account of the final worker action.

location.summary: Ministry schools and contracted cleaning services are identified; no specific school or public gathering place is given.

demands.summary: Sources identify overdue wages to cleaning-company workers and government arrears to contractors. They do not establish whether workers directly demanded action from the state or from private contractor employers.

participants.summary: No participant/worker count or estimate reported.

threshold_50.summary: No count, qualitative estimate or description establishes at least 50 simultaneous participants at a public gathering; strike coverage alone does not prove a gathering.

state_response.summary: Ministry reported steps to pay arrears to contracted companies and the strike crisis ending, but direct concession/response to worker demands is not established.

notes: Candidate retained for review because contemporary sources document a cleaning-company strike resolution by 5-6 December. The onset month, location, turnout, public-gathering form and state-target demand are not established; do not assign December ownership or eligibility without follow-up. State Department custom-page result retained in the source ledger as a blocked ambiguous historical lead only, not event/date evidence.
open_questions: When and where did the strike begin, and which month owns its onset?
Was there a public gathering with at least 50 simultaneous people, rather than only a work stoppage?
Did workers direct wage demands to the Ministry/state over its contractor-payment policy or to private contractor employers?
Which contractor(s), worker group or union organized the action?
What date did the strike end, and what state/employer actions occurred during the episode?
